 Versus  The State of Bihar Bihar  ... ...

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Sumit Kumar Bhagat  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Chandra Bhushan Prasad  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 09-07-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a complaint case punishable for the offence under Sections 304(B), 341, 323, 498A, 506, 328/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. As per prosecution case, daughter of the informant was subjected to cruelty and harassment for dowry by all the F.I.R. named accused persons including these petitioners and ultimately, on 22.08.2023, all the accused persons killed her (informant's daughter) by administering her poison.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.22432 of 2025(2) dt.09-07-2025 4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 is mother-in-law of deceased,
whereas petitioner nos. 2 & 3 are brothers of husband of deceased and are simply victim of over implication.
There is general and omnibus allegation.

He further submits that the husband of deceased and other two co-accused namely Md. Intazar, Md. Salam and Md. Kalam have already been acquitted, vide Judgment dated 19.10.2024 passed in Sessions Trial No. 276 of 2024 by Shama Parveen vs The State Of Bihar on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2306448/
1

sentences.text:
5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the above named petitioners, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purnea in connection with Amour P.S. Case No.
274 of 2023, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Saif/-
